featured_reviews.name: harmeen jaina
featured_reviews.review_text:
I feel truly grateful to be a part of this yoga class. Sabiha ma’am is not just a teacher, but a wonderful human being with such a calm, kind, and motivating nature. She genuinely cares for each and every student and makes sure everyone feels comfortable and supported. Her knowledge about yoga and overall well-being is amazing, and the way she explains things makes it easy for anyone to follow.

What I’ve realized here is that yoga is not just about losing weight—it’s so much more than that. It helps you build physical strength, mental stability, and a deeper connection with yourself. Every session brings something new, whether it’s a technique, a health tip, or a small insight that improves your daily life.

If you’re someone who is not just looking for weight loss but also wants balance, peace, and stability in both body and soul, I would highly recommend this class. It’s truly a beautiful journey towards a healthier and happier you.

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Deshpande
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined this gym about a month ago and it has been a very satisfying experience so far. Although the gym is compact in terms of floor space, it is very well organised and has everything needed for a complete strength training workout.

Since the gym is relatively new, all the machines and equipment are clean, well maintained and smooth to use. They have installed most of the essential equipment for a balanced workout — including a Smith machine, hack squat, leg extension and hamstring curl machines, calf raise, lat pull, cable row, pec deck, cable crossover, chest press machines and adjustable benches for incline, flat and decline presses. There is also an excellent range of dumbbells going up to 50 kg, neatly arranged, along with adequate barbells and weight plates.

The membership fees are quite reasonable, especially for longer-term plans. Another big advantage is the convenient operating hours — the gym is open from 6 a.m. to 12 midnight on weekdays, which makes it easy to work out at almost any time of the day.

The ambience is very good, with bright lighting and soft background music that keeps the energy levels up during workouts and keeps me motivated to come daily.  Basic facilities like a changing room, toilet, hand-wash area and drinking water are also available.

The only drawback at present is the absence of cardio equipment such as treadmills or elliptical machines. Hopefully those will be added in the future.

Overall, it’s a well-equipped gym with a pleasant environment and good value for money.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank You Sir For Your Valuable Feedback 😊

featured_reviews.name: Wahid Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a member of this gym for the last 3 months and my experience has been excellent. The gym is built by Junaid Kaliwala and the overall atmosphere is amazing. It’s a very motivating place to work out, and everything is well organized and clean.

The machines are very good and modern, which makes workouts comfortable and effective. The trainers are also very helpful and friendly. They guide us properly during training and always motivate us to improve.

I also want to mention an incident that shows how honest and supportive the staff are. I accidentally lost ₹10,500 in the gym and didn’t remember where I had kept it. When I called the gym, the staff checked and found the money. I asked them to keep it safely and told them I would collect it the next day. When I went there, they returned the full amount to me. I really appreciate their honesty and kindness.

Because of this experience, I trust this gym even more. Great environment, helpful trainers, good machines, and very honest staff. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a good gym.

featured_reviews.name: dharam dayaramani
featured_reviews.review_text:
This gym truly stands out, not just because of its equipment, but because of the heart behind it. It’s built by an athlete, and you can genuinely feel that passion reflected in every corner of the space.

What makes this place special is the people. The team here is incredibly kind, supportive, and welcoming—you don’t just feel like a member, you feel like part of a family. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and encouragement that instantly lifts your energy.

While good equipment is important (and they have that covered), the real differentiator is the vibe. It’s motivating, positive, and inclusive—exactly what you need to stay consistent and enjoy your fitness journey.

And as a bonus, the lighting here is fantastic. If you’re someone who likes capturing your workouts or progress through photos and videos, this place is perfect.

Overall, a great gym with an even greater atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Vibha Bhatt
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently joined this gym at Mega Mall and I must say it has exceeded my expectations in every way. The facility is spacious, well-organized, and equipped with the latest machines that cater to all types of workouts—whether strength training, cardio, or functional exercises. The ambiance is energetic yet comfortable, making it easy to stay motivated and consistent with workouts. Cleanliness and hygiene are clearly a top priority, with the staff ensuring that all equipment and workout areas are sanitized regularly, which really adds to the overall experience.

The trainers here deserve special mention. They are knowledgeable, approachable, and always ready to guide with proper techniques, personalized routines, and even nutritional tips when needed. Their constant encouragement makes a huge difference, especially for someone like me who sometimes struggles to stay disciplined. What impressed me most is how they pay attention to each member, correcting posture and ensuring safety during workouts—something that not all gyms maintain at this level.

Apart from the workout experience, the gym’s overall vibe is fantastic. The music, lighting, and crowd create a lively atmosphere without ever feeling overcrowded. The management is professional, polite, and transparent about memberships and offers, which builds a lot of trust. I genuinely feel this gym provides excellent value for money and creates an environment where fitness doesn’t feel like a chore, but something to look forward to every day. Highly recommended for anyone looking to seriously invest in their health and fitness journey

featured_reviews.name: Aaqib Merchant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really great experience at this gym. The environment is very positive and motivating and the gym itself is very spacious which makes workouts comfortable and enjoyable. The people here are very understanding and supportive which makes it even better especially for someone trying to stay consistent.

I personally saw amazing results as I increased my weight from 47 kgs to 54 kgs with the help of my personal trainer Faizan sir. He guided me properly and made sure I stayed on track with my workouts and progress.

The service here is very good and everything is well managed. The receptionists are also very helpful and polite and they make sure all your queries are handled smoothly.

Overall this gym provides a great experience and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to improve their fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Nasrin Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Training here has been such a great experience. The vibe of this gym is honestly unmatched—it’s motivating, energetic, and just makes you want to give your best every single day. As someone who both works out and trains clients here, I can genuinely say it’s the perfect environment for growth. The space, the energy, and the people all come together so well. I love everything about this place—it really feels like more than just a gym.
The staff and trainers are amazing—super supportive, friendly, and genuinely invested in your progress.❤️❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Devansh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I initially left a simple 1 star rating without writing a detailed review, but the way this gym has handled the situation forced me to explain why.

After I posted the rating, I started receiving daily calls and messages from them asking me to remove it. It turned into constant harassment. Instead of addressing the actual issue or trying to resolve my concern professionally, the focus was entirely on getting the review taken down.

The owner Junaid bhai mentioned that he has investors and therefore cannot make a decision regarding my membership refund after merely a 30 min gym session. Using that as a reason to avoid accountability while simultaneously pressuring me to remove my feedback is not acceptable.

I was actually being considerate by not writing a detailed review in the first place, but the repeated calls and messages crossed a line. I would strongly caution others before signing up here. Typical sales people being oddly nice to you while signing up. Do not go by their google rating as its very deceptive to appear credible.
